test_split_merge_cbench: test splitting a cBench benchmark by function and merging back to validate semantics
test_split_globalopt_merge_safe_unsafe: test that strip actions cause invalid results when used before split and merge
test_strip_unsafe_for_split: test that strip actions raise BenchmarkInitError when used with split and merge
run_split_benchmark_by_function: run llvm.split_benchmark_by_function to split a benchmark into per-function benchmarks
run_merge_benchmarks: run llvm.merge_benchmarks to merge a list of split benchmarks back into one
